annotation.kind: source selection, tier label, and exact finite-vector realization of the four-source xi aggregate in equation (3.8)

assumptions: The weights alpha, beta, and lambda are nonnegative.
Each of the four error-vector norms is bounded by its corresponding source magnitude.

conditions.L: The identical fixed statement and P19 shared files are present; the frozen NumStability library is also present.
conditions.N: The fixed statement and P19 shared files are present; no NumStability artifact is present.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p19_t2_modular_four_source_error_bound {n : Nat} (alpha beta lambda epsilonC epsilonB ug epsilonX : Real) (computationError rhsError gmresError solutionError : Fin n -> Real) (halpha : 0 <= alpha) (hbeta : 0 <= beta) (hlambda : 0 <= lambda) (hcomputation : p19VecNorm2 computationError <= epsilonC) (hrhs : p19VecNorm2 rhsError <= epsilonB) (hgmres : p19VecNorm2 gmresError <= ug) (hsolution : p19VecNorm2 solutionError <= epsilonX) : p19VecNorm2 (p19ModularError alpha beta lambda computationError rhsError gmresError solutionError) <= p19ModularEnvelope alpha beta lambda epsilonC epsilonB ug epsilonX
formal_statement.plain_language: A four-source modular error vector has norm bounded by the exact weighted xi envelope from equation (3.8).

informal_proof: Apply Euclidean homogeneity to each weighted source, use its supplied norm bound, and combine the four contributions with three applications of the triangle inequality.
informal_statement: An exact finite-vector certificate for the four weighted terms collected in xi in the modular forward-error bound (3.8).
